messages.snippet: James, I confirm we have exchanged contracts on Cedarbridge Business Park at £14,250,000, completion
messages.subject: Project Cedar - EXCHANGED
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

I confirm we have exchanged contracts on Cedarbridge Business Park at £14,250,000, completion 12 December 2025. We hold the deposit of £1,425,000 as stakeholder. Please send the completion documents list and the TR1 engrossment.

Oliver
